description: This file defines a custom exception class `ProvisioningCriteriaCannotBeDeletedException` used within the provisioning provisioning module of Apache Fineract. The exception indicates that certain provisioning criteria cannot be deleted because they are associated with existing journal entries.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: A custom exception extending AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, thrown when provisioning criteria cannot be deleted due to existing associations.

methods.name: ProvisioningCriteriaCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that takes a criteria ID and passes an error message code and description to the superclass.
